data.name: Meta_LanguageName
data.comment: This language's name in itself, shown in the Options dropdown. A language picker names each language the way its own speakers write it, so this is the one key a translator writes in their own language rather than translating: Deutsch, not German.

data.name: Meta_ShippedLanguages
data.comment: Every language tag this build ships, comma separated, English first. Adding a language means dropping in Strings.<tag>.resx and adding its tag here - the whole of it. Read from this file only, never from a translation, so translating this key cannot change what the app offers.

data.name: Options_Language_Description
data.value: The language this app's own text is read in. System default follows the display language Windows is set to. Mod names, descriptions and changelogs come from the Forge and stay in whatever language their author wrote them in.

data.name: Options_Language_SystemDefaultFormat
data.comment: {0} is the language following Windows currently lands on, named in itself - "System default (English)".

data.name: Common_ClearFilters
data.comment: Button label, on both Browse and Installed. Each page explains its own in a tooltip.

data.name: Common_SaveAsDefault
data.comment: Button label, on both Browse and Installed.

data.name: Common_Previous
data.comment: Pager button, on both Browse and Installed. The previous page of results.

data.name: Common_Next
data.comment: Pager button, on both Browse and Installed.

data.name: Common_PinnedToolTip
data.value: Pinned - no mod list you apply will set this mod aside
data.comment: On the pin icon. Four copies of this sentence across Browse and Installed's three views.

data.name: Common_DownloadsFormat
data.comment: {0} is a download count. Keep the :N0 - it is what groups the thousands the way the user's Windows regional setting does.

data.name: Common_SearchPlaceholder
data.comment: Placeholder in the search box. "@author" is typed syntax, not a word - leave it as it is and translate only the sentence around it.

data.name: Common_ClearFiltersToolTip
data.value: Puts every filter back to what this page opens with.

data.name: Common_AttributeFilterToolTip
data.value: Filter by Fika support, ads, AI content, dependencies and addons
data.comment: Fika is a mod's name and stays as it is.

data.name: Common_PageSizeToolTip
data.value: How many cards make up one page

data.name: Common_PageSizeFormat
data.comment: One entry in the page-size dropdown. {0} is a number of cards.

data.name: Common_PagerFormat
data.comment: The pager under the results. {0} is the page being shown, {1} the number of pages.

data.name: Dependencies_Refresh
data.comment: Button label - re-runs the dependency scan.

data.name: ModDetails_Close
data.comment: Tooltip on the mod details dialog's close button.

data.name: ModDetails_CategoryFormat
data.comment: {0} is a category name from the Forge, which arrives in its author's language and is not translated here.

data.name: ModDetails_LicenseFormat
data.comment: {0} is a licence name, e.g. "MIT".

data.name: Addons_Description
data.value: Extra content published for this mod. An addon's versions are matched against the mod's installed version, not your SPT version.

data.name: Addons_OpenPage
data.value: Open this addon's page on sp-mod.com
data.comment: sp-mod.com is a domain and stays as it is.

data.name: Addons_InstalledFormat
data.comment: {0} is a version number.

data.name: Dependencies_Description
data.value: Every installed mod that declares dependencies, and whether each one is satisfied. Mods needing attention are listed first and start expanded.

data.name: Browse_SaveAsDefaultToolTip
data.value: Opens this page with the filters, sort and per-page it is set to right now, including the SPT version ticks. The search box is not included. Options can clear it again.

data.name: Browse_RefreshCache
data.comment: Button label - re-fetches the mod catalog from sp-mod.com.

data.name: Browse_SptVersionFilterToolTip
data.value: Filter by the SPT releases a mod supports

data.name: Browse_SptVersionItemFormat
data.comment: One tick box in the SPT version filter. {0} is a version number; SPT is a product name.

data.name: Browse_CategoryFilterToolTip
data.value: Filter by the category a mod is listed under

data.name: Browse_FeaturedFilterToolTip
data.value: Whether mods featured on sp-mod.com are included

data.name: Browse_ByAuthorFormat
data.comment: {0} is an author's name, shown under a mod's title on its card.

data.name: Browse_EndorsementsFormat
data.comment: {0} is a count, never zero - a card with none hides this line. Keep the :N0.

data.name: Browse_BadgeFikaCompatible
data.comment: Badge on a mod card. Fika is a mod's name and stays as it is.

data.name: Browse_BadgeContainsAds
data.comment: Badge on a mod card.

data.name: Browse_BadgeHasDependencies
data.comment: Badge on a mod card.

data.name: Browse_AddonBadgeToolTip
data.value: Open this mod to see and install its addons

data.name: Browse_StartupProgressFormat
data.comment: First-run progress while the catalog downloads. {0} is how many have arrived, {1} the total.

data.name: Browse_FirstLaunchNote
data.value: The first launch downloads the mod catalog. After that it's read from disk and this is over in a moment.

data.name: Installed_Rescan
data.comment: Button label - reads the install folder again.

data.name: Installed_MultiSelect
data.comment: Button label - turns the card grid into a tick list.

data.name: Installed_MultiSelectToolTip
data.value: Tick several mods to enable or disable them together

data.name: Installed_ExpandAllToolTip
data.value: Open every mod the filters match

data.name: Installed_CollapseAllToolTip
data.value: Close every mod the filters match

data.name: Installed_ViewCards
data.comment: One of the three view buttons. A grid of cards.

data.name: Installed_ViewGroups
data.comment: One of the three view buttons. Mods sorted into the user's own groups.

data.name: Installed_ViewGroupsToolTip
data.value: Sort mods into your own groups, MO2-separator style.
data.comment: MO2 is Mod Organizer 2, another modding tool - a name, not a word.

data.name: Installed_ViewList
data.comment: One of the three view buttons. One row per mod.

data.name: Installed_ViewListToolTip
data.value: One scrollable row per mod, each opening onto its full details.

data.name: Installed_ListBadges
data.comment: Label on the switch that shows mod-list chips on each mod. "List" here means a mod list, not the List view.

data.name: Installed_ListBadgesToolTip
data.value: Show which mod lists each mod belongs to.

data.name: Installed_SaveAsDefaultToolTip
data.value: Opens this page with the filters, sort, view and per-page it is set to right now. The search box is not included. Options can clear it again.

data.name: Installed_UpdateFilterToolTip
data.value: Filter by whether an update is available

data.name: Installed_EnabledFilterToolTip
data.value: Filter by whether a mod is enabled or disabled

data.name: Installed_CategoryFilterToolTip
data.value: Filter by the category a mod is listed under on sp-mod.com

data.name: Installed_GroupFilterToolTip
data.value: Filter by one of your own mod groups

data.name: Installed_SelectionClear
data.comment: Button label - unticks everything currently selected.

data.name: Installed_SelectAllToolTip
data.value: Select everything the current filters match, across every page - not just the page on screen.

data.name: Installed_UpdateSelectedToolTip
data.value: Queue an update for every selected mod that has one. Mods with no update, disabled mods and addons are skipped.

data.name: Installed_SortGroupsLabel
data.comment: Label to the left of the group sort dropdown.

data.name: Installed_NewGroupPlaceholder
data.comment: Placeholder in the box beside Add group.
